notes.title: Unleash your inner monkey: TOSS!🍌 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=QcXWv2auBpQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]TOSS IS OUT NOW![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/

TOSS!🍌 has been with us for close to five years, and it's difficult to put into words just how excited we are to finally share it with all of you.

The sheer love and effort we've poured into making TOSS!🍌 is something we will remember as part of this amazing time, and the tons of feedback and encouragement we have gotten from you - the awesome players - is what has been pushing us.

We are super proud of what we've accomplished, and thrilled to continue our journey on TOSS!🍌 together with you!

[h3][b]WHAT TO EXPECT[/b][/h3]

Swing and toss yourself freely across spacey jungle-gym playgrounds, as an acrobatic monkey, in this bananas VR platformer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/63b9cc960ff7d4201aa1299f0c7b997d02b9f3da.png[/img]

You've crash landed on a cloud planet and will need to collect parts to repair your ship as you launch yourself around 75+ playground levels in 9 vibrant cloudscape biomes and rank-up to become a TOSS!🍌 master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/9a8747638a93f76034cfd6c21c764b6d4f05a0bd.png[/img]

This VR game uniquely captures the agility, timing and gamer skill required to play the beloved platformer classics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/dec52a3ce7cbe9fba8a579781126c12cf7c43146.png[/img]


🐵 [b]PARKOUR ACTION:[/b] Soar and launch yourselves through the air, grab hold of trees, pipes, and walls.

🔥 [b]CHALLENGES:[/b] Try to race against the clock, with Time Attack; find as many bananas as possible or master as few grabs as possible in each round.

🍌 [b]SOCIAL COMPETITION:[/b] Compete against each other by time and rank, and follow your friends' leaderboard ghosts.

🥋 [b]MASTERY & MODIFIERS:[/b] Unlock modifiers like Zero Gravity and Double Toss by becoming a TOSS!🍌 master!

[h3][b]GRAB IT NOW[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/

-- Albin, Simon, Eddie & Toss

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tossvr]TikTok [/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/TossVR]Twitter [/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/TossVR/]Instagram[/url]

notes.title: Traffic Jams is out now!
notes.notes:
Today is the day! The teams from Vertigo Games and Little Chicken Game Company are happy to share with you that Traffic Jams is out now on Steam! [b]Traffic Jams[/b] is a tongue-in-cheek VR sim with a wacky take on traffic controlling and an asymmetrical multiplayer mode that will let you share the fun with the whole family, your friends - and yes, even your online followers

Watch the launch trailer, which shows off a sneak peek of the game’s career mode, its wacky crossroads full of unexpected turns, and asymmetrical multiplayer mode:

[previewyoutube=trETkh4nBnI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Multiplayer mode![/b]
In addition to single-player, Traffic Jams also supports a couch party mode, uniting VR and non-VR players in asymmetrical party play. Up to 4 non-VR friends can join in on the road mayhem using their mobile devices. Manipulating traffic and events with the push of a button, mobile players will need to work together closely with the VR player to complete their objectives before time runs out.

To stay up to date on all news coming your way, find us on [url=http://facebook.com/vertigogames]Facebook[/url], [url=http://twitter.com/vertigogames]Twitter [/url]and [url=http://instagram.com/vertigogames]Instagram[/url] and subscribe to the newsletter at [url=http://trafficjams-vr.com][b]trafficjams-vr.com[/b][/url].

notes.title: Control The Chaos in Traffic Jams!
notes.notes:
In the world of Traffic Jams all traffic lights have gone out and you are the only one who can keep traffic flowing in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. 

[previewyoutube=CdnuadgEanA;full][/previewyoutube]

In this demo, you'll be able to take on the small town of Gouda where it’s up to you to guide rude pedestrians, impatient drivers, and the occasional meteorite along before road rage strikes. Sound easy? Think again! This chaotic VR game is full of monsters, (un)natural disasters, and something called… ‘cheese bowling’?

You’ll be taken under the wing of Dennis, the self-proclaimed world’s best traffic controller… EVER!!! He comes from a place called Jam City, which gets its name from its many flash mobs and packed intersections. Armed with dreams of superstardom, a sassy attitude and fresh dance moves, he has taken it upon himself to teach YOU the ropes of traffic controlling (although between you and me, he’d rather be dancing). If you give him a chance, he’ll take you on a jam-packed global adventure to become the Ultimate Traffic Showman.

Traffic Jams is releasing on Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and major PC VR headsets in September of this year, featuring a career mode that will take you across some of the most iconic cities around the globe and (couch) party mode, where up to 4 non-VR friends can join in on the road mayhem using their mobile devices!

For more news about Traffic Jams, wishlist the game on Steam, find us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram and subscribe to the newsletter at trafficjams-vr.com.
